content:
## Testing settings | Setting and Description | Default | |------------------------|---------------| | `setting(github.copilot.chat.generateTests.codeLens)` _(Experimental)_
Show **Generate tests** code lens for symbols that are not covered by current test coverage information. | `false` | | `setting(github.copilot.chat.setupTests.enabled)` _(Experimental)_
Enables the experimental `/setupTests` intent and prompting in `/tests` generation. | `true` |
